The white surface is unnaturally smooth and uniform, lacking the expected panel seams, rivets, or slight imperfections found on real large-scale metal dishes. It has a 'plastic' rendered look.
The elliptical projection of the dish rim is slightly inconsistent with the angle of the feed horn assembly, suggesting minor geometric warping.
